senses.gloss: m. pl. (סְפוֹג) cakes made of spongy dough, a sort of crackers.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:4">Ḥall. I, 4</cite>, expl. Y. ib. 57ᵈ <cite ref="I00817"><he>טְרִיקְטָא</he></cite>. Ḥall. l. c. 5 <he>תחלתה עיסה וסופה ס׳</he> if his first intention was to make regular dough (for bread), and then it was changed for crackers. Y. l. c. <he>ס׳ שנעשו באור</he> crackers baked over fire, opp. <he>בחמה</he> baked in the sun.
